title: Wheel zoom band clamp [1.0, 4.0] has no pin on the wheel path (camera_zoom_at)
evidence:
app/main.odin:1728:	z_to := clamp(rnd.camera_zoom_step(app.cam_zoom_to, delta), rnd.CAM_ZOOM_MIN, rnd.CAM_ZOOM_MAX)
app/pullback_test.odin:206-209 (the only wheel-path zoom assertions):
	// the wheel elsewhere: zooms (delta -1 — the fixture sits at the 4.0 max,
	// a +1 notch would clamp and look like a no-op)
	before := app.cam_zoom_to
	effect_zoom(&app, &app.input, -1, {100, 100})
	testing.expect(t, app.cam_zoom_to != before, "a wheel off the panel zooms the map")
detail: Acceptance says 'Wheel zoom-to-point, clamped', but no test asserts the 4.0 ceiling or 1.0 floor via the wheel; the test even sidesteps the clamp (+1 'would clamp'). Clamp-removal regressions pass all pins.
recommended_fix: Add a pin calling camera_zoom_at from zoom 1.0 with +20 and from 4.0 with -20 notches, asserting cam_zoom_to == 4.0 and == 1.0.

title: W5 fold (pan converts against the LIVE zoom) untested — effect_pan has zero value assertions
evidence:
app/main.odin:1751:	nx, ny := rnd.camera_pan_center(app.cam_wx_to, app.cam_wy_to, dx, dy, fit, app.cam_zoom)
app/pullback_test.odin:137-139 (the only non-modal effect_pan call):
	arm_pullback(&app2)
	effect_pan(&app2, &app2.input, 50, 0)
	testing.expect(t, !app2.pullback, "the drag-pan yields the pullback")
detail: The fixture is mid-ease (cam_zoom=4.0 live vs cam_zoom_to≈2.13 target), yet no assertion reads cam_wx_to/cam_wy_to. The W5 regression (live→target zoom) and effect_pan's clamp application pass all tests.
recommended_fix: After arming a pullback (zoom≠target), call effect_pan(50,0) and assert cam_wx_to moved by exactly 50/(fit*cam_zoom_live), clamped — pinning both the W5 choice and composition.

title: Pullback ease-rate band (~1.5-2 s ruling) weakly pinned — a 0.14-rate regression passes
detail: Gap after 30 frames: 0.05 rate → 0.40; 0.14 rate → 1.87·0.86³⁰ ≈ 0.020, still above the 0.005 snap. Both stay 'in flight', so CAMERA_PULLBACK_EASE=0.05 regressing to 0.14 (~0.66 s, outside the ruled band) is undetected.
recommended_fix: Assert a discriminating bound after 30 frames, e.g. cam_zoom - target > 0.1 (passes at 0.05's 0.40 residue, fails at 0.14's 0.02).

title: camera_newest_terminals has no direct unit pin — defensive edges and the event↔id ordering unpinned
detail: Only the feed-level test covers it (one interleaved router — the kind-filter core IS pinned non-vacuously). Unpinned: found<n bail, >8 same-frame spawns (silent pullback skip via the [8]u32 buffer), dead-id skip, and the 'event i maps to ids[n_spawns-1-i]' ordering.
recommended_fix: Add a direct unit pin in camera_test.odin: mixed junction/terminal ids, dead nodes, n>len(ids) (expect found==len(ids)), and newest-first ordering.

title: poll_mouse wheel seam (w != 0 gate, residue persistence, notch emission) untested — acceptable raylib boundary
detail: The gate, per-frame residue persistence in Input, and notch!=0 emission read live raylib state, untestable without device injection. The pure accumulator and the full chain above the seam are pinned; consistent with the repo's untested poll seam.
recommended_fix: Optionally extract 'gate + persist' into a pure helper (residue, raw) -> (event, residue) and pin it; otherwise accept as the established poll boundary.

title: PR-body claim 'a second SEED mid-ease retargets it' has no test
evidence:
_pr_body_camera_zoom.md:45-46:
  settings panel row 5 (AUTO PULLBACK), DEFAULT ON (the MM default),
  persisted in the v2 settings file (v1 files load with pullback ON — existing
  players' a11y settings survive the upgrade). Any user camera input (wheel,
  pan,
  selection, ESC) yields the pullback instantly; a second SEED mid-ease
  retargets it.
(pullback_test.odin: every pullback_feed call arms from a settled fixture; no test feeds a second seed while app.pullback is true)
detail: A claimed behavior of the ruling's implementation (mid-ease retarget) is unpinned: a regression that early-outs when pullback is already armed would pass all 31 app tests.
recommended_fix: Arm a pullback, run camera_update ~10 frames (mid-ease), feed a second far seed, assert cam_zoom_to/cam_wx_to retargeted and pullback still true.

title: W4 pin's fixture-id comments are wrong: claims 'id 6'/'id 7', actual ids are 3 and 4
evidence:
app/pullback_test.odin:102-103:
	place_router(&app, {30, 10}) // id 6: a junction, no event (the skewer)
	spawn_with_event(&app, {23, 10}) // id 7: the seed, >= 10 tiles from every terminal
(core/types.odin:551-566 run_init spawns nothing — 'topology_make' on a zeroed state; core/topology.odin:135-138 id := t.next_node_id; t.next_node_id += 1 — monotonic from 0; fixture spawns res,res,rt = ids 0,1,2, so the router is id 3 and the seed id 4)
detail: The N4 disease (comments contradicting the actual ids) in a new pin. Assertions are id-agnostic so the pin still bites, but the comments mislead future readers auditing the walk.
recommended_fix: Correct the comments to id 3 / id 4, or drop the specific ids.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: Measured on head 9094f45: odin test app/render=61, app/input=12, app=31, all green (matches the briefing's 31/12/61/236 claim). Pin counts 9/7/7/2 new. B1 fold FULL (camera_test.odin:107-114 asserts floor z==1.0 + center pin + district inclusion); B2 FULL (policy 6 branches + hit 8 cases + composition routing); B3 FULL (7 yield clears, touch deltas through touch_map, latch lifecycle + stale predicate); settings v1→v2 FULL (settings_v1_file_loads_with_pullback_default_on + W6 mixed corruption). Unpinned: wheel band clamp (main.odin:1728), live-zoom pan fold (main.odin:1751), ease-rate band, mid-ease retarget.
detail: P0 100% (zoom/pan/pullback/settings critical paths incl. all three r2 blocker folds). P1 ≈87% (34/39 sub-behaviors — the four gaps above). Overall ≈86%. P1 sits in the 80-89% CONCERNS band.
